summary: Verifies that public trace capture and gate paths now require explicit torch dtype, device placement, runtime parameter dtype/device sets, synchronized timing-clock metadata, and a refusal to treat capture timing as named-hardware promotion evidence.

online_research_basis.note: from_pretrained/model loading is part of runtime provenance; dtype/device must be explicit.
attention backend identity is explicitly selectable and must be bound to dtype/device.
CUDA events are timing/synchronization markers; timing provenance must identify clock and synchronization.
